commands.command:
cd /etc/pg-ca
for n in node1:10.100.170.10 node2:10.100.170.11 node3:10.100.170.12; do
  name=${n%%:*}; ip=${n##*:}
  openssl genrsa -out ${name}.key 2048
  chmod 600 ${name}.key
  openssl req -new -key ${name}.key -subj "/CN=${name}" -out ${name}.csr
  cat > ${name}.ext <<EOF
subjectAltName=DNS:${name},IP:${ip}
extendedKeyUsage=serverAuth,clientAuth
EOF
  openssl x509 -req -in ${name}.csr -CA ca.crt -CAkey ca.key -CAcreateserial -out ${name}.crt -days 825 -sha256 -extfile ${name}.ext
done
# client cert for replication role
openssl genrsa -out replicator.key 2048

openssl x509 -req -in replicator.csr -CA ca.crt -CAkey ca.key -CAcreateserial -out replicator.crt -days 825 -sha256
